messages:
sam (partnerships): CloudMarket wants a joint perf-per-watt benchmark for their marketplace tile. They offered a credits package if we do a clean dataset and co-branded blog. Need proposal for metrics and owners.
rachel (perf): I'm happy to own. Core metrics: tokens/s, p50/p95 latency, avg_power_W (chassis-level), tokens_per_joule. Also capture IRQ/CPU steal if on shared infra.
kai (eng-runtime): We'll run bench-v3 with a reduced workload first. Suggested config: model=redwood-6b, precision=int8, batch=[1,4,8], seq=[64,256], replicates=3, power_poll=1s.
sam (partnerships): CloudMarket requested kernel-tune notes included. What kernel flags should we sweep?
kai (eng-runtime): Minimal sweep: fuse_attention toggles, matmul_tile_size, thread_affinity. Record kernel commit hash and compiler flags.
jules@cloudmarket: Jules here — we can provide 3 marketplace test nodes with remote telemetry (PDU + cloud agent). We need your runbook to onboard nodes and an embargo window of 5 business days after results are published.
rops-bot: Note: node allocation request must include user list and maintenance windows.
rachel (perf): Acceptance criteria for public listing: tokens_per_joule >= internal baseline * 1.07 AND no p95 regression >6%. If not met, label results as "partner internal" and iterate.
kai (eng-runtime): ingestion fields: run_id,timestamp_iso,node_id,model,precision,batch,seq,tokens,duration_s,power_w_avg,kernel_flags,notes. I'll add an example to the repo.
sam (partnerships): owners: runbook=sam; bench infra=rachel; runtime+kernel=kai; partner liason=jules.
bench-bot: Action queued: create-runbook (id: cm-bench-20260323). ETA 1h.
jules@cloudmarket: we'll send agent install script and a sample telemetry payload by EOD.
ops-bot: Rack note: these nodes in marketplace pool are in zone-c, power headroom 2.5kW per rack. Please schedule during low-traffic window.
sam (partnerships): scheduling: dry-run Thurs 11am PT, full run Mon. I'll send invites and draft co-brand blurb for legal review.
rachel (perf): I'll run a canary on Thurs and post preliminary numbers in the runbook.
kai (eng-runtime): reminder: capture kernel git SHA and gcc version in outputs. Use /var/log/bench/cloudmarket.
sam (partnerships): any blockers? otherwise moving this to the runbook.
rachel (perf): none. :thumbsup:
jules@cloudmarket: no blockers from CloudMarket side. Will confirm agent creds.
bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run meeting in 48h (link: https://meet.redwood/cloudmarket-dryrun).
sam (partnerships): thanks — closing and tracking in doc.
